title: Fill the Menu
story: The tea stall keeps prices in a dictionary.
goal: Add samosa at 30, then print samosa plus the tea price: 40
hints: The first blank is the new key (it needs quotes, it is text).
The second is the dictionary method that looks up a key safely: get.
socratic: What goes inside the square brackets when adding a new item?
Which method reads a value without crashing if missing?
Compare your output with the goal. What differs?
explain: In one sentence: what did the blank teach you in “Fill the Menu”?
